protection.q: Can I protect older, used, or unlocked phones?
protection.a: Yes! Unlike AppleCare or carrier insurance that must be purchased within 30–60 days of buying a brand new phone, AKKO covers new, used, refurbished, and unlocked phones regardless of when you bought them.

protection.q: How do repairs work at Mobicare?
protection.a: When your phone breaks, file a quick 60-second claim on the AKKO app. Select Mobicare Device Recovery as your authorized service provider.
